name: Better Coupon Restrictions for WooCommerce
author: Elliot Sowersby / RelyWP

sections.description:
Better Coupon Restrictions adds additional restrictions and options to your WooCommerce coupons.

When enabled, you will see a new “Better Coupon Restrictions” tab in the coupon edit screen.

From there, you can set the following additional restrictions:

  • Improved Product Restrictions: This section improves the default product usage restrictions allowing you to set a minimum and maximum quantity for each.

  • Product Category Restrictions: This section improves the default product category usage restrictions allowing you to set a minimum and maximum quantity for each.

  • Cart Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based that cart quantity, subtotal, and total weight.

  • Date Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the current date including a date range, select months, or weekdays.

  • Customer Status Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s status including if they are a new customer, or their logged in status.

  • User Role Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s user role.

PRO Version

The PRO version of Better Coupon Restrictions includes the following additional features:

  • Customer Address Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s billing and shipping address. You can also set a maximum use per address.

  • Customer Order History Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s order history including their total spent and total orders.

  • Time Since Last Order Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the time since the customer’s last order.

  • Time Registered Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the time since the customer registered.

  • Referring Domain Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the referring domain.

  • IP Address Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s IP address including allowed and disallowed IP addresses, along with a usage limit per IP.

  • Meta Data Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s meta data.

  • Cookie Restrictions: This section allows you to set restrictions based on the customer’s cookies.

Learn more about Better Coupon Restrictions PRO
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to the WooCommerce > Coupons page, and edit a coupon to see the new “Better Coupon Restrictions” tab.
sections.faq:
How do I set the new restrictions on a coupon?

After installing and activating the plugin, go to the WooCommerce > Coupons page, and edit a coupon to see the new “Better Coupon Restrictions” tab.
